errors.text_span: der IWF-Fiskalindex darstellt, der bei etwa 0,1 im Jahr 1995 beginnt
errors.evidence: Description states 0.1 in 1995, but the figure shows it starting at 0.
Description states it rises to 0.6 in 2006; the figure shows it peaks at around 1.
Description states it drops to 0.3 in 2012; the figure shows it falling to around 0.4.
Description states it rises to 1.7 in 2020; the figure shows it is closer to 1.5.

errors.text_span: die bei etwa 40 im Jahr 1995 beginnen
errors.evidence: Description states 40 in 1995; the figure shows it starting at approximately 60.
Description states it rises to 60 in 2007; the figure shows about 70.
Description states it drops to 40 in 2012; the figure shows it is closer to 50.
Description states it rises to 65 in 2020; the figure shows it is closer to 70.

errors.text_span: die bei etwa 0,3 im Jahr 1995 beginnt
errors.evidence: Description states it starts at 0.3 in the second diagram; the figure shows it starts at –5.
The description does not mention that the right vertical axis measures Schuldenquote from 30 to 70.
The description fails to mention that the left y-axis represents the Schuldenquote for Gesamtstaat and the right y-axis for Zentralstaat.
